doc.title: Sheryl Bailey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 24, 2023

title: First jazz guitar and her mother seeing her success
summary: She bought a cherry ES 335, found a practice schedule split between metal and jazz, and her mother saw her in the Monk competition.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. Did you have to go out and then get a different kind of guitar?

I did. Well I did. I bought a — I had an ES 335, a cherry finish, that I bought. I think it was $600 then which is amazing. But I still have, actually I wish I’d saved it, when we cleaned out my mother’s home I found a practice schedule that I had where I was torn between heavy metal and jazz and I had my practice schedule and it was cut in half. Like an hour on this and an hour — that’s the way kids think, it’s just funny.
Great. Did your mom get to see some of your successes?
Yes she did, absolutely. And I mean I was in the Monk competition and she was able to see that. Yeah. Yeah. She got to see that the music lessons paid off.
